settings.aboutTitle: We build products people actually love to use.
settings.aboutText: Lumora is a product studio crafting connected devices and software that disappear into your day. Every detail is considered, from the first sketch to the last line of code, so that technology feels calm, beautiful and effortless.
settings.ctaText: Tell us about your idea and our team will get back to you within one business day.

slides.title: The future of the connected home
slides.subtitle: One beautifully simple hub that brings every device in your home together.

slides.title: Hardware and software in perfect sync
slides.subtitle: We design every layer so our products just work, together, out of the box.

slides.title: Designed to feel like light
slides.subtitle: Calm, considered technology that fits naturally into the way you live.

products.name: Orbit 2
products.description: Orbit connects lights, locks, speakers and sensors into one calm, private system. Set it up in minutes, control it with your voice, and forget it's even there.

products.name: Pulse Band
products.description: A featherlight band that tracks sleep, recovery and activity with clinical-grade sensors, and turns the data into guidance you can actually use.

products.name: Halo Lamp
products.description: Halo shifts its colour temperature through the day to match natural daylight, helping you focus in the morning and wind down at night.

products.name: Aero Buds
products.tagline: Sound with nothing in the way.
products.description: Studio-tuned wireless earbuds with adaptive noise cancellation and spatial audio, in a case smaller than a matchbox.

products.name: Vertex Studio
products.description: Vertex Studio is the app that ties every Lumora product together, with automations, insights and a dashboard that's a joy to open.
